avoid: That Darcy comes to love Elizabeth, proposes to her or marries her; his letter; his good character under the pride; Pemberley as a place they visit.
That Lydia elopes with Wickham, or marries him.
That Collins proposes to Elizabeth, that she refuses him, or that he marries Charlotte Lucas.
Anything about Wickham's past with Darcy (the living, Georgiana), his lies, his debts, or his elopement with Lydia.
That Darcy does not marry her, that he marries Elizabeth, or that Lady Catherine later tries to stop that engagement.
